3532-5078-6792-8346.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6792-8346.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

2099-2558-6277--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2099-2558-6277--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
On Wings of Gold triggers. Holding priority, activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a 1/1 creature token. The +1/+1 bonus from On Wings of Gold is countered by the -1/-1 from the templated card
Repeat from step 2.

751-4927-6723.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

822-1719-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
822-1719-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

2738-4871-6026-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Field of Souls, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1965-2034-5224-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
1965-2034-5224-7693.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Omarthis.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Omarthis, adding {C}{C}.
When Omarthis dies, it and Together Forever trigger.
Resolve the Omarthis trigger, manifesting the top card of your library.
Resolve the Together Forever trigger, returning Omarthis from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

856-5315-5776-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

240-413-5470-7175.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1270-1350-4050-6972-7312.description:
Cast Triceraton Commander by paying {4}{W}{W} minus {1} or {W} for each creature you can tap to help cast it due to its convoke ability.
When Triceraton Commander enters, it triggers, creating six 2/2 Dinosaur Soldier creature tokens due to Ojer Taq.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Triceraton Commander from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Triceraton Commander by paying {0} and tapping six Dinosaur Soldiers due to its convoke ability.
When Triceraton Commander enters, it triggers, creating six 2/2 Dinosaur Soldier creature tokens due to Ojer Taq.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Dinosaur Soldiers, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat from step 3.
1270-1350-4050-6972-7312.notes: The mana cost can be reduced to a minimum of {2}{W} if you can tap creatures to help cast Triceraton Commander in step 1.

2292-3991-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1475-2921-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control another nonland creature with power 1 or greater that does not have One with the Kami attached to it.
1475-2921-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control with power 1 or greater.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and One with the Kami trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the land's power.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

232-864-1235-4285.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Eternal Witness.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Eternal Witness with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Eternal Witness tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

486-1978-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with toughness 3 or greater.
486-1978-6478.description:
Cause Arbor Adherent to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2267-5220-6705-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2267-5220-6705-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1921-4404-4659.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Corridor Monitor from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Corridor Monitor token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Corridor Monitor token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Corridor Monitor token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Corridor Monitor token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

1115-1563-2457-3000.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

333-5617-6797.notablePrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-5617-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

1543-2061-4231-5469-6717.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Academy Manufactor.
When the Academy Manufactor token enters the battlefield, Tezzeret triggers, putting a loyalty counter on it.
Activate Transmutation Font by tapping it, creating three Food, Clue and Treasure tokens.
When the tokens enter the battlefield, Tezzeret triggers nine times, putting nine loyalty counters on it.
Activate Tezzeret using the ability granted to it by Ichormoon Gauntlet by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Academy Manufactor.
When the Academy Manufactor token enters the battlefield, Tezzeret triggers, putting a loyalty counter on it.
Activate Transmutation Font by tapping it, creating nine Food, Clue and Treasure tokens.
When the tokens enter the battlefield, Tezzeret triggers 27 times, putting 27 loyalty counters on it.
Activate Tezzeret using the ability granted to it by Ichormoon Gauntlet by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 9 each turn.
1543-2061-4231-5469-6717.notes: You can continually make more Academy Manufactors each turn, which will progressively give you more Clues, Foods and Treasures each turn.

3372-3668-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Flesh Duplicate
3372-3668-5466.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Flesh Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Flesh Duplicate's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Flesh Duplicate's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Flesh Duplicate's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

1580-2060-5231-6701.description:
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1580-2060-5231-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

539-2034-5003-6528.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashaya, adding {C}{C}.
When Ashaya dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ashaya enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
If you control a nontoken creature that has haste, you may instead sacrifice it, and then tap it each iteration to get infinite green mana and colorless mana.

4823-4871-5231-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
4823-4871-5231-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Timeless Witness and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Timeless Witness, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2060-2092-3062-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2092-3062-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1617-2897-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Gigantoplasm on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-2897-4831-4983-5358.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Gigantoplasm to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

1621-3647-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Displace.
1621-3647-4605.description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
Wispweaver Angel and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another creature you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-3480-5686.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-3480-5686.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1603-2713-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Evil Twin has a power of at least 2.
1603-2713-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Evil Twin and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Evil Twin from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Evil Twin to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Evil Twin enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Evil Twin by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

3617-4477-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Walk and Greenwarden of Murasa each turn.
3617-4477-6122.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa by paying its mana cost.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1792-5034-5864.notablePrerequisites: You control a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog that does not have summoning sickness.
1792-5034-5864.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog you control that does not have summoning sickness.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve Retraction Helix.
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist.

3388-5231--5.description:
Activate Thermopod's last ability by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost, adding {R}.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, it triggers its persist ability, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of the creature with persist with two +1/+1 counters and one -1/-1 counter on it.
Remove one +1/+1 counter and one -1/-1 counter from Moritte of the Frost as a state-based action.
Repeat.

101-3047-4050.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying {B}, targeting Vampire Charmseeker.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vampire Charmseeker, adding {B}.
When Vampire Charmseeker dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Feign Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3430-3525-3793-4720.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Apprentice Wizard.
Apprentice Wizard does not have summoning sickness.
3430-3525-3793-4720.description:
Activate Apprentice Wizard by paying {U} and tapping it, adding nine {C}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Apprentice Wizard.
Repeat.

404-1322-1521-2105.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
404-1322-1521-2105.description:
Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.

518-519-5109.notablePrerequisites: An additional creature on the battlefield under any player's control.
518-519-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, triggering itself, targeting any other creature.
In response, cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting the same creature and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Resolve Volcano Hellion's trigger, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to the targeted creature and to you, reducing your life total to 1 due to Worship.
Arcbond's delayed triggered ability triggers, dealing an equal amount of damage to all other creatures and all players, which again does not reduce your life total below 1.
